placement_axes.label: Machine Logic vs Void Austerity
placement_axes.description: Separates users drawn to artifact automation, constructed engines, and machine-like problem solving from users drawn to Wastes, Eldrazi alienness, desolation, or the void branch.
placement_axes.rationale: The sourced notes make the artifact camp versus Wastes/void camp a useful internal discriminator without making either branch all of Colorless.
placement_axes.notes: Internal branch axis only; do not treat either endpoint as sufficient Colorless proof.

placement_axes.label: Restriction Puzzle vs Titan Spectacle
placement_axes.description: Separates attraction to colorless as a hard deckbuilding puzzle from attraction to enormous Eldrazi and spectacular high-mana moments.

placement_axes.notes: Vox Mana synthesis; not an official Wizards Colorless player profile.

placement_axes.notes: Candidate axis only; current price/metagame claims are Manual fill required.
